app.title: Zhenxia · Video archive
library.heading: Keep what you love
library.description: Build your personal video archive, one link at a time.
download.label: Video link
download.placeholder: Paste a video link or share text…
search.label: Search resources
empty.title: Your archive starts here
empty.description: Paste a video link above. Your downloads will appear here.
jobs.description: Task history stays local. Retry a download if it fails.
jobs.empty.title: No downloads yet
jobs.empty.description: Add your first link from the library.
settings.description: Manage login sessions for each platform.
cookie.title: Douyin cookies
cookie.description: Sign in to Douyin, then open Developer Tools → Network, select a request and copy its Cookie header. Credentials stay in this deployment’s data directory and are never displayed back.
cookie.label: Douyin Cookie header
cookie.placeholder: Paste the full Cookie header (save empty to clear)
cookie.note: Douyin uses its own download engine. Public videos are read through a browser page; login requirements, verification, or unavailable content may still prevent downloads.
about.title: About this workspace
about.description: Media is stored in Downloaded, task and resource records in data/zhenxia.db, and session credentials in data. Removed files move to Downloaded/.trash and can be restored manually. This deployment is local only and has no multi-user authentication.
about.credit: Zhenxia · Powered by douyin-downloader and yt-dlp, with FFmpeg for merging video and audio.
preview.label: Preview {name}
file.trashed: Moved to Downloaded/.trash. You can restore it manually.

platform.title: Other platform cookies
platform.label: Choose a platform
platform.description: Try public videos without cookies first. If login is required, paste a Netscape cookie file containing only domains for the selected platform (not a Cookie request header). Credentials stay local and are never displayed again.
platform.placeholder:
# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
Paste exported cookie file contents; save empty to clear
platform.note: Single videos only; YouTube Shorts, TikTok short links, and individual X posts are accepted. Channels, playlists, live streams, Telegram, and TikTok photo posts are not supported. Up to 1080p, 10 media items, 2 GB, and 10 minutes per task.
error.server.23: Enter a video link or share text
error.server.25: Use a single video link; channels, playlists, and live streams are not supported
error.server.26: Unsupported platform. Use a Douyin, YouTube, TikTok, X, or Bilibili link
error.server.27: Cookies are not supported for this platform
error.server.30: Cookie domains do not match the selected platform
error.server.31: Download directories cannot be symbolic links
error.server.33: The download process exited unexpectedly; check the runtime environment
error.server.34: The platform requires login or verification. Check its cookies and network, or try again later
error.server.35: Cannot connect to the video platform. Check the network or proxy configuration
error.server.36: A download component is unavailable. Check FFmpeg and the JavaScript runtime
error.server.37: Video extraction or download failed. Check the link, platform restrictions, or update yt-dlp
error.server.38: Download exceeds the 2 GB task limit
error.server.39: Live and upcoming streams are not supported
error.server.40: No downloadable video was found; it may exceed the size limit or require login
progress.waiting: No media data received yet. Waiting for the platform; if this persists, check your network or proxy.
transcript.title: Speech to text (upstream settings)
transcript.scope: Applies only to the upstream Douyin batch engine. Single videos and other platforms are not integrated. When enabled, eligible media is uploaded to the configured service and may incur charges. Saving settings does not call the service.
transcript.key-placeholder: Leave blank to keep saved key; never displayed again
error.server.41: TikTok returned an unrecognized webpage response, possibly due to verification, regional restrictions, or site changes. Try another video or configure TikTok cookies.
error.server.42: The video domain referenced by this post is unavailable. Try another video link.
login.title: TikTok sign-in
login.description: Sign in using a temporary browser to save this platform session automatically. Sign in again or clear local credentials; clearing does not revoke sessions on TikTok.
login.instructions: This is a temporary server browser. Click a field, enter text below and send it. Use Enter, Backspace and scrolling, or scan a platform QR code with your phone. TikTok site login only; third-party login popups are not supported. The window expires after 10 minutes.
login.input: Click a field in the screen, then enter text here
login.confirm-clear: Clear the locally saved TikTok session?
login.state.waiting: Complete sign-in; the session will be saved automatically
login.state.expired: Sign-in expired and browser closed. Open it again.
login.state.failed: Cannot open sign-in page or browser closed. Check the network/proxy or try again.
login.state.region_blocked: TikTok redirected this connection to its Hong Kong service-discontinuation page. Sign-in is unavailable. Choose a network/proxy region where TikTok is available and reopen sign-in.
limits.title: Download size limit
limits.label: Per-task limit (GB, 0 = unlimited; multi-platform engine only)
error.server.100: Download exceeded the task size limit. Adjust it in Settings.
error.server.101: No format matches the requested quality. Try another video or retry later.
error.server.102: The media URL expired or is unavailable (HTTP 404). Retry later.
error.server.103: The platform rejected extraction (HTTP 400). Check platform cookies or update yt-dlp.
